title: RICHEST MUSICIANS
subtitle: NET WORTH - 2010 to 2026
outro:
Follow for the money
nobody explains.
vo: In twenty ten, the richest names in music were old-school moguls. Then the game changed. Jay-Z built an empire far beyond rap. Rihanna made more from makeup than music. Kanye chased fashion. And Taylor Swift, on the strength of her own catalog and tours, joined the billionaires club. By twenty twenty-six, music money looks nothing like before. Who's next? Follow, for the money nobody explains.
